title: TerraClimate climate normals, 1991–2020: monthly means of daily maximum and minimum temperature, and monthly precipitation
provider: Climatology Lab, University of California, Merced (Abatzoglou et al. 2018), served by the THREDDS server of the Northwest Knowledge Network, University of Idaho

tmax.long_name: Daily maximum air temperature at 2 m
tmax.cell_methods: time: maximum within days time: mean over days time: mean over years

tmin.long_name: Daily minimum air temperature at 2 m
tmin.cell_methods: time: minimum within days time: mean over days time: mean over years

ppt.cell_methods: time: sum within months time: mean over years

stride.description: take every stride-th point of the 1/24° grid (8: a point every 1/3°)

format: netCDF classic, one file per variable: 12 months × latitude × longitude, point samples of the 1/24° (about 4 km) grid, not area means. Temperatures in °C; precipitation in mm per month (1 mm is 1 kg m-2 of water). Ocean cells have no value. The source's time axis counts months of the year (1 to 12).
coverage: Land surfaces of the whole Earth, including Antarctica; the normal year of 1991–2020
licence: CC0 1.0, public domain (as stated in the Google Earth Engine catalogue entry for TerraClimate)
citation: Abatzoglou, J. T., S. Z. Dobrowski, S. A. Parks and K. C. Hegewisch (2018), TerraClimate, a high-resolution global dataset of monthly climate and climatic water balance from 1958–2015, Scientific Data 5, 170191.
